projectTitle: Major depressive disorder dorsolateral prefrontal cortex versus control
contrastDefinition: Human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (BA8/9) bulk RNA-seq from major depressive disorder versus unaffected control donors
sampleGroupSource: Human-only GPL11154 series matrix subset restricted to dlPFC samples; contrast labels parsed from `phenotype` in GEO sample characteristics.
batchHandlingRule: DESeq2 design = ~ gender + age + pmi + ph + rin + group on the human dlPFC subset; medication and smoking fields omitted because of missingness.
notes: Mental-health extension cohort. Uses the human GPL11154 arm only and excludes mouse GPL13112 samples entirely.
designFormula: ~ gender + age + pmi + ph + rin + group
